statement: If as many even numbers as we please be added together, the whole is even.
heath_proof: For let as many even numbers as we please, AB, BC, CD, DE, be added together; I say that the whole AE is even. For, since each of the numbers AB, BC, CD, DE is even, it has a half part; [VII. Def. 6] so that the whole AE also has a half part. But an even number is that which is divisible into two equal parts; therefore AE is even.
ai_proof_text:
9.21
**Statement:** If as many even numbers as we please be added together, the whole is even.

**Step 1.** Let as many even numbers as we please, AB, BC, CD, DE, be added together, and let the whole be AE. I say that AE is even.

**Step 2.** Since AB is even, it is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]; let AB be divided into the two equal parts AG, GB, so that AG is equal to GB. For the same reason each of BC, CD, DE is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]; let BC be divided into the equal parts BH, HC, CD into the equal parts CK, KD, and DE into the equal parts DL, LE.

**Step 3.** Let the number F be made up of AG, BH, CK, DL added together, and let the number G' be made up of GB, HC, KD, LE added together. Since AG is equal to GB, BH to HC, CK to KD, and DL to LE, and if equals be added to equals the wholes are equal [CN2], therefore F is equal to G'.

**Step 4.** But F and G' added together make up AG, GB, BH, HC, CK, KD, DL, LE all together, that is, AB, BC, CD, DE together, which is the whole AE. Therefore AE is divided into the two equal parts F, G'.

**Step 5.** Therefore AE is divisible into two equal parts; and a number which is divisible into two equal parts is even [D7.6]. Therefore AE is even.

**Step 6.** Therefore, if as many even numbers as we please be added together, the whole is even. Q.E.D.
